families.name: surface_relevancy_hint

As DOSE grows, the reminder becomes more explicit and more distractor admissible commands (repeated look/examine on the already-seen desk) are trimmed from the admissible list.
families.why: The policy is stuck on desk 1 using/turning on the desklamp before it has the cellphone. Removing the premature desklamp action and prompting continued search redirects it toward locating and taking the cellphone, which is the missing progress.

families.name: search_ordering_heuristic
families.mechanism: Block (reject) actions that turn on the desklamp before the cellphone is held, and with growing DOSE also block repeated no-op look/examine actions on an already-visited location to force exploration of unseen surfaces/containers. Blocking that premature action (and, at higher dose, the redundant look/examine loop) prevents the dead-end and pushes the policy to explore until it finds and takes the cellphone.
